## buy

Show replacement candidates for my team (position, budget, club limit)

```text
Usage: fplr buy [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -o, --out <ID>             Player ID to sell (repeatable); limits candidates to the same position and budget
  -p, --position <POSITION>  Filter by position [possible values: goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward]
      --max-cost <MAX_COST>  Maximum cost (e.g. 7.5)
  -s, --sort <SORT>          Sort by metric [default: form] [possible values: form, xgi, fdr, pts]
  -w, --weeks <WEEKS>        Number of upcoming gameweeks to check fixtures for [default: 3]
  -l, --limit <LIMIT>        Number of players to show per position [default: 10]
```

## history

Show manager's season history

```text
Usage: fplr history [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -m, --manager-id <MANAGER_ID>  Manager ID (uses configured ID if not provided)
```

## manager

Show a specific manager's team

```text
Usage: fplr manager [OPTIONS] <MANAGER_ID>

Arguments:
  <MANAGER_ID>  Manager ID

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>   Specific Gameweek (defaults to current)
```

## mini-league

Show mini-league standings

```text
Usage: fplr mini-league [OPTIONS] <LEAGUE_ID>

Arguments:
  <LEAGUE_ID>  League ID

Options:
  -e, --entry <ENTRY>  Highlight your entry ID
```

## my-leagues

Show my leagues

```text
Usage: fplr my-leagues [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -m, --manager-id <MANAGER_ID>  Manager ID (uses configured ID if not provided)
```

## my-team

Show my team

```text
Usage: fplr my-team [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>   Optional Gameweek ID. If not provided, uses the current Gameweek
```

## pick

Show a manager's team picks for a specific event

```text
Usage: fplr pick [OPTIONS] <MANAGER_ID> <EVENT_ID>

Arguments:
  <MANAGER_ID>  Manager ID (entry ID)
  <EVENT_ID>    Event ID
```

## sell

Show sell candidates from my team (availability, fixtures, minutes)

```text
Usage: fplr sell [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -w, --weeks <WEEKS>  Number of upcoming gameweeks to check fixtures for [default: 3]
  -l, --last <LAST>    Number of recent finished gameweeks to check minutes for [default: 3]
```
